scopes_needed_read: all-apis (default) or scoped secret such as 'sql'
auth.refresh: Re-request via client_credentials; token endpoint https://<workspace>/oidc/v1/token or accounts.cloud.databricks.com/oidc/accounts/<account-id>/v1/token

access_requirements.customer_admin_must_do: Create a service principal, generate an OAuth secret, grant Unity Catalog privileges and CAN USE on a SQL warehouse, then send us workspace host, client ID and secret via our secure form. Alternative with no credentials: Delta Sharing.

customer_grant_statements: Docs form: GRANT USE CATALOG ON CATALOG <catalog> TO `<service-principal-application-id>`;
GRANT USE SCHEMA ON SCHEMA <catalog>.<schema> TO `<service-principal-application-id>`;

GRANT SELECT ON TABLE <catalog>.<schema>.<table> TO `<service-principal-application-id>`;   (SELECT follows documented pattern GRANT <privilege> ON <securable-type> <name> TO <principal>; Databricks page gave USE CATALOG/USE SCHEMA examples verbatim)
Warehouse access: SQL warehouse permissions > CAN USE for the service principal (UI/API; statement UNVERIFIED).
incremental_sync: Delta Change Data Feed (table_changes) or timestamp cursor (UNVERIFIED not fetched)
blockers: Per-workspace host and warehouse ID; customer must run a warehouse
sources: https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/dev-tools/auth/oauth-m2m — 'grant_type=client_credentials&scope=all-apis'; 'Each access token is valid for one hour'
https://docs.databricks.com/aws/en/data-governance/unity-catalog/manage-privileges/ — GRANT USE CATALOG ON CATALOG main TO `finance-team`; GRANT USE SCHEMA ON SCHEMA main.default TO `finance-team`
